data.name: Yoginder
data.gender_notes: Yoginder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Yogi (practitioner of yoga) + Indra (God of rain, thunder, and storms). The name Yoginder carries the meaning “Divine Inder (God)” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Yoginder usually hope their child will grow to embody divine inder (god) and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the union of the divine inner self and the supreme consciousness
data.etymology: Yoginder belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Divine Inder (God).”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Yoginder total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.

data.cultural_impact: The name Yoginder carries a strong Hindu cultural significance as it is derived from the Sanskrit words "Yogi" and "Indra". The word "Yogi" refers to an individual who practices yoga, a physical, mental, and spiritual discipline originating from ancient India, to attain self-realization and liberation. The word "Indra" signifies the ancient Hindu deity of rain, thunder, and storms, who is known as the king of the gods and ruler of the heavens. Thus, a name like Yoginder signifies a strong connection to Hindu spiritual practices and the reverence for Hindu deities.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Yoginder carries significant spiritual meaning as it combines the essence of ancient Hindu spiritual practices and the reverence for the Hindu deity Indra. The practice of yoga is believed to purify the body and mind, enabling individuals to connect with their higher consciousness and ultimately, to reach a state of enlightenment. On the other hand, the name Indra signifies the power of nature, reminding us of the interconnectedness of all creation and the importance of respecting the natural world. Together, the name Yoginder encourages one to seek inner peace and outer harmony, embodying the values of self-discipline and connection to the natural world and the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Yoginder: One who is dedicated to the practice of yoga, finding inner peace and unity with the divine. This name signifies the continuous journey towards self-realization and union with the supreme consciousness.

historical_references.reference: The name Yoginder has been used throughout Hindu history by sages, scholars, and devotees who exemplified its meaning.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Yoginder is of Hindu origin and translates to 'one who practices yoga'. In modern times, this name has gained popularity due to the rise of yoga as a global trend. Yoginder is often used as a username or profile name on various social media platforms, particularly those focused on health and wellness.
